messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0315-42 - High 95th percentile tail latency on /v1/generate (hosted). Trigger: api.latency.p95 > 800ms for 5m. Paging: @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

mira: seeing the alerts. current pg metric shows spike started ~10:02 UTC. customers affected? any errors?

ajay: looking at traces now. error rate is flat, it's latency only. traces point to a single model pool (redwood-gpu-pool-2) with long KV cache misses.

taylor: hmm could be cache eviction after a large batch of long-context requests. I pushed a quick metric dashboard widget earlier but not enough detail.

sre-oncall: i'm on it. handoff note: i'll mute noisy p95 alerts for the next 10m while we triage (will record change).

incident-bot: @sre-oncall muted alert api.latency.p95 for 10m (reason: active triage).

mira: estimation: ~3% of requests > 1s, 99th spikes at 2.4s. Sending customer-facing note to #support after we have RCA guess.

ajay: digging into host metrics -> GPU util on pool-2 nodes looks normal, but there are bursts of host-side CPU steal on one instance (gpu-12). Could be background job.

leo: i see a scheduled backup job started 10:00 on gpu-12 — that was supposed to be disabled for prod, but apparently the cron landed.

jess: who owns that cron? we should stop it now.

leo: ops-scheduler did, ops-runbook team. @taylor can you reach out?

taylor: pinging ops-scheduler, will cancel immediate run.

incident-bot: ops-scheduler: backup-job-2026 triggered on gpu-12 at 10:00 UTC.

ajay: once the backup started, latency p95 climbed from 220ms -> 1.3s in ~2m. KV cache miss rate for the pool jumped x3.

mira: mitigation plan: cancel backup job, cordon gpu-12 from serving, shift some traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (lower mem but same quality) to reduce cache pressure.

sre-oncall: executing mitigation steps: 1) cancel job 2) cordon node 3) update router weight 4) watch p95.

incident-bot: Action log: @sre-oncall canceled backup-job-2026 at 10:06 UTC.

jess: after cancel, p95 dropped to ~400ms within 3m, 95th trending down. still noisy though. any alert tuning we should do live?

mira: we shouldn't raise thresholds permanently. For live mitigation, lowering alert sensitivity to reduce noise while we confirm is ok. Suggest change: api.latency.p95 alert from 800ms for 5m -> 900ms for 10m temporarily.

ajay: agree. Also add a new alert targeting the specific model pool: api.latency.p95{pool="redwood-gpu-pool-2"} > 800ms for 3m to avoid global pages for pool-local issues.

incident-bot: @mira created a task: TEMP_ALERT_TUNING-177 (change threshold and duration).

leo: we need better dashboards to see these relationships quickly. Current grafana panels show p95 and traffic but not cache miss heatmap nor background job overlay. We should add panels for: KV cache miss rate by pool, background job start markers, node-level CPU steal, and per-pool p95 drilldown.

taylor: drafting dashboard layout in #grafana-design, starting a quick retrospective dashboard: panels -> 1) Golden signals summary (p95, error rate, saturation) 2) Pool heatmap (p95 per pool over time) 3) KV cache miss rate (stacked by pool) 4) Node events (annotations for scheduled jobs) 5) Drilldown: traces link for slow requests.

mira: can you paste example queries? i'd add a Grafana panel with threshold bands and a template var for pool.

ajay: pasting quick PromQL snippets (mocked):

```
# p95 by pool (histogram_quantile on request_duration_seconds_bucket)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api",route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, pool))

# KV cache miss rate per pool
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (pool)

# node cpu steal
100 - avg(irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) by (instance) * 100
```

jess: nice. for annotations: we can push a grafana annotation via POST when backup job starts. Add an annotation panel that queries "annotations" datasource or use sentinel events.

leo: also recommend adding a derived panel that correlates p95 and KV miss rate with a crosshair. that'll speed RCA during incidents.

sre-oncall: updated live: router weight adjusted (pool-2 -> -40%), cordoned node gpu-12. p95 back to 260ms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation actions applied; impact reduced. Status -> investigating.

mira: decision: keep incident open until new dashboard + alert changes are deployed and we confirm stable for 1hr. assign owners: dashboard->leo, alert changes->ajay, runbook update->taylor.

ajay: i've opened PR to add pool-scoped alert rules and increased p95 firing window for global rule. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/4523

leo: creating grafana dashboard draft now - dashboard UID temp: KX8yRz. Will add panels and share link.

jess: note for retro: we should reduce reliance on global p95 only. Add separate golden signals: per-pool p95, end-to-end error budget burn, queue length, and KV cache hit ratio.

mira: agreed. also add runbook step: if a scheduled job touches prod GPU nodes, it should escalate to ops-runbook and be blocked. Add a monitor for cron events hitting prod nodes.

taylor: will update runbook. also adding an automated playbook snippet to annotate Grafana when we cordon nodes (so timeline visible).

mira: support notified with preliminary customer impact note: ~3-5% requests impacted, degraded latency for ~12m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-0315-42 -> status: resolved at 10:30 UTC (root cause: unintended backup cron on gpu-12 causing KV cache pressure). Postmortem planned.

mira: follow-ups: (1) dashboard by EOD (leo) (2) alert rule PR merge (ajay) (3) runbook + cron guard (taylor) (4) postmortem doc (mira+team).

ajay: tagging code snippets for dashboard panels in the PR description.

leo: sharing dashboard link in channel when ready. will include panel JSON snippets.

jess: retro note: consider a Grafana alert that fires when scheduled job starts on prod GPU tag -> should page runbook owner not oncall unless >10m.

sre-oncall: thanks team. good triage.

mira: closing notes: keep temp tuning changes documented in the alerting repo and revert if not needed after 48h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Follow-up checklist created: [dashboard-KX8yRz], [PR-4523], [runbook-cron-guard].
